metas.name: White House Farm
metas.description: Factual drama based on the notorious White House Farm murders, and the ensuing police investigation and court case.

metas.name: Painkiller
metas.description: The causes and consequences of America's opioid epidemic unfold in this drama following its perpetrators, victims and an investigator seeking the truth.

metas.name: Memory of a Killer
metas.description: Angelo Doyle lives two totally separate lives — fearsome NYC hitman and sleepy upstate Cooperstown photocopier salesman and father. Both of them are threatened when he is diagnosed with Alzheimer's, a disease he already lost his older brother to.

metas.name: Defending Jacob
metas.description: A family's lives are irreparably disrupted when the 14-year-old son is accused of murdering a fellow classmate.

metas.name: Countdown
metas.description: When an officer with the Department of Homeland Security is murdered in broad daylight, LAPD detective Mark Meachum is recruited to a secret task force, alongside undercover agents from all branches of law enforcement, to investigate. But the hunt for the killer soon uncovers a plot far more sinister than anyone could have imagined, kicking off a race against time to save a city of millions.

metas.name: Tracker
metas.description: Lone-wolf survivalist Colter Shaw roams the country as a “reward seeker,” using his expert tracking skills to help private citizens and law enforcement solve all manner of mysteries while contending with his own fractured family.

metas.name: Your Friends & Neighbors
metas.description: When a financial titan suddenly finds himself divorced and jobless, he starts robbing his wealthy neighbors to stay afloat. Stealing from his own social circle strangely exhilarates him—but he gradually gets tangled in a deadly web.

metas.name: The Last Frontier
metas.description: When a prison transport plane crashes in the remote Alaskan wilderness—freeing dozens of violent inmates—the region's lone marshal must protect the town he's vowed to keep safe.

metas.name: Litvinenko
metas.description: The story of the determined Scotland Yard Officers who worked to prove who was responsible for the death of Alexander Litvinenko, in one of the most complex and dangerous investigations in the history of the Metropolitan Police.

metas.name: Steal
metas.description: A typical day at Lochmill Capital is upended when armed thieves burst in and force Zara and her best friend Luke to execute their demands. In the aftermath, conflicted detective Rhys races against time to find out who stole £4 billion pounds of people's pensions and why.

metas.name: Boston Blue
metas.description: NYPD Detective Danny Reagan takes a job with the Boston PD and is paired with Detective Lena Silver, part of a law enforcement family comprised of District Attorney Mae Silver, Police Superintendent Sarah Silver, rookie cop Jonah Silver and Rev. Edwin Peters. Reagan hopes to reconnect with his son, Sean, in Boston.

metas.name: Mare of Easttown
metas.description: A detective in a small Pennsylvania town investigates a local murder while trying to keep her life from falling apart.

metas.name: Nemesis
metas.description: A relentless LAPD cop becomes obsessed with taking down the master thief behind a string of daring heists — and only one can come out on top.

metas.name: East New York
metas.description: Regina Haywood is the newly promoted deputy inspector of East New York, a working-class neighborhood at the edge of Brooklyn. She leads a diverse group of officers and detectives, some of whom are reluctant to deploy her creative methods of serving and protecting in the midst of social upheaval and the early seeds of gentrification.

metas.name: The Gold
metas.description: On 26 November 1983, six armed men break into the Brink's-Mat security depot, stumbling across gold bullion worth £26m.

metas.name: Devil in Disguise: John Wayne Gacy
metas.description: When a teenager goes missing, it becomes clear that many young men and boys have disappeared at the hands of John Wayne Gacy, the prime suspect.

metas.name: Law & Order Toronto: Criminal Intent
metas.description: An elite squad of detectives investigate high-profile crime and corruption in metro Toronto.

metas.name: Sherlock
metas.description: A modern update finds the famous sleuth and his doctor partner solving crime in 21st century London.

metas.name: On Call
metas.description: Traci Harmon, a veteran female training officer, and her rookie male ride-along, Alex Diaz, navigate the loss of a fellow officer and politics of modern day policing  — in the department and on the streets of Long Beach.

metas.name: HIS & HERS
metas.description: Two estranged spouses — one a detective, the other a news reporter — vie to solve a murder in which each believes the other is a prime suspect.
